_note: Synthetic, hand-labelled demo cases. Not real calls and not a clinical benchmark. 'expected' lists the life-threat categories a dispatcher should be alerted to. Categories: BREATHING, UNCONSCIOUS, CHEST_PAIN, BLEEDING, TRAPPED, FIRE, SMOKE.
